title: HR policy assistant
description: Answers about leave, expenses and conduct that point to the policy and the right approver.

train.prompt: How many vacation days do I get in my first year?
train.completion: Check your contract and the leave policy for your country. Your remaining balance is shown in the HR portal.

train.prompt: Can I carry unused vacation days into next year?
train.completion: The leave policy sets how many days can be carried over and the deadline to use them. Check the HR portal or ask HR for your country's rule.

train.prompt: I am sick today. What do I need to do?
train.completion: Tell your manager before your shift starts and record sick leave in the HR portal. A doctor's note is needed after the number of days set in the policy.

train.prompt: Can my manager approve my expense claim for a team dinner?
train.completion: Yes, if the cost is within the meal limit in the expense policy. Attach the itemised receipt and list the attendees.

train.prompt: I want to work from another country for a month.
train.completion: Working abroad needs approval from your manager and HR because of tax and visa rules. Submit a remote work request before you travel.

train.prompt: A coworker keeps making jokes about my accent. What can I do?
train.completion: You can report it to your manager, to HR, or through the confidential reporting line. Retaliation for reporting is not allowed.

train.prompt: How do I request parental leave?
train.completion: Tell your manager and submit a parental leave request in the HR portal with the expected date. HR will confirm your entitlement.

train.prompt: Can I tell a candidate their salary offer on the phone before HR approves it?
train.completion: No. Wait until HR has approved the offer, then share it in writing through the official offer letter.

train.prompt: I forgot to clock in this morning.
train.completion: Submit a time correction in the HR portal today with your actual start time, and your manager will approve it.

train.prompt: Can I accept a gift from a supplier?
train.completion: Check the gifts policy. Small gifts under the limit can be accepted but must be declared. Decline cash and anything above the limit.

train.prompt: I want to change my bank account for salary payments.
train.completion: Update your bank details in the HR portal before the payroll cut-off date. Changes after the cut-off apply next month.

train.prompt: How do I resign and what notice do I need to give?
train.completion: Give written notice to your manager. The notice period is in your contract. HR will confirm your last working day and final pay.

val.prompt: Can I take two days off tomorrow without asking anyone?
val.completion: No. Request the leave in the HR portal and get your manager's approval before taking time off.

val.prompt: I was charged for a hotel twice on my company card.
val.completion: Contact the hotel for a refund of the duplicate charge and flag it in your expense report so finance can track it.

val.prompt: Is it okay to share my colleague's salary with my team?
val.completion: No. Salary data of other employees is confidential and must not be shared.

val.prompt: I need to leave early every Friday for a medical treatment.
val.completion: Talk to your manager and HR about a flexible schedule. You do not need to share medical details beyond what the policy requires.
